description: With an unknown argument, a result that can't be evaluated for its type still fails
notes: The README and the package documentation don't say whether parameters accept unknown values. hashicorp/hcl declares them without AllowUnknown (decodeUserFunctions in ext/userfunc/decode.go), so by the spec's call rules the result is an unknown value of the result type, which go-cty's Function.Call returns without calling the implementation. That type comes from the function's type callback, which evaluates the result expression with the unknown arguments (spec.Type in decodeUserFunctions). The spec doesn't say what happens when a function fails (see native/functions/function-error-is-eval-error). hashicorp/hcl returns the diagnostics of evaluating the result expression as the function's error, first from the type callback that go-cty calls before the implementation (spec.Type in decodeUserFunctions in ext/userfunc/decode.go), and FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go reports an error from a function as an error in the call.
